summary: The High Court issued an order nisi requiring the state to explain why Police Ordinance Amendment No. 37 should not be repealed.
notes: This is a procedural stage in the same Police Ordinance Amendment litigation already represented by LEAD-2022-0004, which preserves the enacted law and the later January 2025 final High Court disposition. It is therefore merged rather than counted as a new accountability event. The June 18 order did not itself strike down the law or establish personal misconduct by Ben-Gvir; no motive or final legal conclusion is inferred from the procedural order.
